title: TechMoon
description: A tech-based survival modpack with many well-known mods such as Appliedenergistics2, Mekanism and Create.
body:
**TechMoon**
A technology-based modpack with many exciting mods. With well-known mods like **Create**, **Applied Energistics 2**, **Mekanism**, **Bioms O' Plenty**, etc.

You can play it with your friends or alone.

## Features:
- **Bioms O' Plenty** adds new Bioms to the game
- **Applied Energistics 2** is a very powerfull storage Mod
- **Mekanism (and a lot of addons)** is a technical mod too. You can build a Fusion reactor or a simpler Wind generator
- **Create (and a lot of addons)** is a cinetic energy mod with trains and Windmills
- **Pam's Harvestcraft** adds over 180 new Food to eat
- and a lot of other mods
